reviewScope: Fresh comparison of all 36 units and both English fields against supplied Chinese and both complete linked references. This supplement is separate from the date-review schema and does not amend Chinese, dates, or source files.

corrections.before: In the third year, sent his heir apparent Jun with Ke leading cavalry seventeen thousand east to raid Puyu, took it, captured their king and division host over fifty thousand mouths and returned.
corrections.after: In the third year, he sent his heir apparent Jun and Ke to lead seventeen thousand cavalry eastward in a raid on Puyu. They took it, captured its king and more than fifty thousand of its people, and returned.
corrections.sourceReason: 世子俊與恪率騎 identifies Jun and Ke in the expedition’s leadership; the current fragment Jun with Ke leading leaves the coordination unnecessarily unclear. 部眾五萬餘口 denotes the people captured with their king, counted as persons, not a distinct division host or necessarily fifty thousand soldiers. The complete Tongjian account likewise distinguishes Jun’s direction and Ke’s military responsibility and records 部落五萬餘口. Preserve the literal third year without selecting an era or silently adding 十. The en field already uses and Ke and a population rendering, so it needs no parallel replacement.
